fusions.name: Cast Net
fusions.desc: Throws a weighted net that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 12 damage, with 80% of that to every enemy within 3 tiles. Everything it hits is stunned for 1 second.

fusions.name: Shimmer Spray
fusions.desc: Flashes a cone of silver shimmer 5 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 3 damage to everything in it with a 30% chance to leave each target [Blunted] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Fold the Light
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, 40% of the elemental damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Silver Weave
fusions.desc: In daylight, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
